user.title: Add a LumaShow
user.description: Enter the address of the Show on your network. A Show that is on and paired with Home Assistant is found by itself: look under Discovered first.

data_description.port: Leave it as it is unless you know the Show listens somewhere else.

discovery_confirm.title: Add {name}?
discovery_confirm.description:
{name} ({host}) is on your network and can share its screen with Home Assistant.

Nothing is shared until you choose what the Show is given (Configure, after you add it). If you have added this Show's ESPHome device, its key is used and you type nothing.

key.title: The key of {name}
key.description: This Show has no ESPHome device in Home Assistant, or its key did not work. Pair the Show with Home Assistant first (on the Show: Pair with Home Assistant), or enter the Show's 44-character key here.

reauth_confirm.title: {name} was paired again
reauth_confirm.description: The Show no longer accepts the key. Pair it again (on the Show: Pair with Home Assistant) and add it in the ESPHome integration, or enter its new 44-character key here.

error.cannot_connect: The Show cannot be reached. Is it on, paired with Home Assistant, and is the LumaShow integration on in its Settings?
error.invalid_auth: The Show does not accept this key.
error.invalid_key: A key is 44 characters: letters, digits, + / and an = at the end.

abort.cannot_connect: The Show cannot be reached. Is it on, and is the LumaShow integration on in its Settings?
abort.not_lumashow: That is not a LumaShow device.
abort.reauth_successful: The Show accepts the key again.

init.title: What this Show is given
init.description:
{summary}

The Show sees only the entities on its list and can do only what you allow below. Nothing is shared until you add something.

menu_options.pick_type: Add by type (lights, climate, cameras, locks...)
menu_options.pick_entities: Edit the list, one entity at a time

pick_area.title: Add by area
pick_area.description: Adds the entities of these areas to the list, once. Entities added to an area later are not shared until you add them.

data.include_minor: Also hidden, diagnostic and configuration entities

pick_device.title: Add by device
pick_device.description: Adds the entities of these devices to the list, once.

data.include_minor: Also hidden, diagnostic and configuration entities

pick_type.title: Add by type
pick_type.description: Adds every entity of these kinds in the house to the list, once (or only those in the areas you choose). Scripts and automations are added only when you pick them here or by name.

data.include_minor: Also hidden, diagnostic and configuration entities

pick_entities.title: The list
pick_entities.description: Exactly what the Show is given. Take an entity off to stop sharing it; add one by name.

copy_assist.title: Copy what Assist can see
copy_assist.description: Assist (the voice assistant) can see {count} entities, which is usually almost everything. This only adds them to the list once; it is not a default and nothing follows Assist afterwards.

control.title: What the Show may control
control.description: By default the Show may only look. Tick the kinds of entity it may act on (a light's on, off and brightness, a cover's open and close, a thermostat's setpoint...). Entities you hold read-only are never acted on.

data_description.control_domains: Only the everyday actions of each kind. Unlocking, disarming, opening a garage door or a gate and turning a camera or a siren off are sensitive and are chosen separately.
data_description.read_only: Entities of the kinds above that the Show may look at but never act on.

sensitive.title: Sensitive actions
sensitive.description: {count} entities on the list have actions that are sensitive: unlocking, disarming an alarm, opening a garage door or a gate, opening a valve, turning a camera or a siren off. They are off unless you pick the entity here. Even then the Show must ask on its own screen, with a fresh confirmation and the PIN, and a voice or a plugin can never ask. Locking, arming and closing need no PIN.

pin.title: PIN
pin.description: The PIN is {set}. It is kept as a hash in Home Assistant; the Show never holds it. Leave the new PIN empty to remove it (and the sensitive actions with it).

data.forward_notifications: Show Home Assistant's notifications on the Show
data.share_streams: Share camera addresses with the Show

data_description.forward_notifications: Persistent notifications (a low battery, a leak sensor) appear in the Show's notifications. Off by default.
data_description.share_streams: The Show always gets a temporary address for each shared camera's picture. This also gives it the camera's stream address, which can contain a password. Off by default.
data_description.share_alarms: The Show gets the alarms of the calendar named LumaShow alarms (calendar.lumashow_alarms) and can add, change and delete them; Shows that share alarms keep each other's alarms in step. Off by default.

error.pin_wrong: That is not the current PIN.
error.pin_mismatch: The two PINs are not the same.
